metal:clean_dry.preparation: Keep clean and dry; remove loose parts and check for sharp edges.
metal:clean_dry.disposal: Metal acceptance varies by local collection. Confirm with your local provider before setting it out.
metal:clean_dry.safety_warning: Do not include batteries, pressurised containers, or sharp unsafe pieces.

metal:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate from other materials and let it dry only if safe to handle.
metal:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not include while wet or contaminated; ask the local provider about acceptance.
metal:contaminated_wet.safety_warning: Avoid unknown residues and sharp edges.

metal:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle or place broken, sharp, or unsafe metal in community pickup.
metal:broken_unsafe.disposal: Use a suitable local hazardous or bulky-waste service.
metal:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep away from people and children.

metal:unknown.preparation: Check condition and remove loose parts only if safe.
metal:unknown.disposal: Confirm item type and local acceptance before setting it out.
metal:unknown.safety_warning: Do not handle sharp or contaminated items.

trash:clean_dry.disposal: Use the usual local residual-waste service; this item is not accepted as recycling guidance.

trash:contaminated_wet.preparation: Keep contained and separate from recyclable materials.
trash:contaminated_wet.disposal: Use the usual local residual-waste service.

trash:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not place unsafe or sharp waste loose in a bag.
trash:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask the local authority about safe disposal.
trash:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep away from people and children.

trash:unknown.preparation: Keep separate until the item is identified.
trash:unknown.disposal: Confirm the correct local residual-waste route.
trash:unknown.safety_warning: Do not handle unknown hazardous contents.

glass:clean_dry.preparation: Empty and rinse if safe; keep intact and dry.
glass:clean_dry.disposal: Confirm whether your local provider accepts this glass type.

glass:contaminated_wet.preparation: Rinse only if safe, then dry and keep intact.
glass:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not set out while contaminated; confirm local glass acceptance.

glass:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle or place broken glass in community pickup.
glass:broken_unsafe.disposal: Follow local guidance for safely containing and disposing of broken glass.
glass:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Broken glass can cause serious cuts.

glass:unknown.preparation: Check whether the glass is intact; keep it separate.
glass:unknown.disposal: Confirm material type and local acceptance before setting it out.
glass:unknown.safety_warning: Do not handle chipped or broken glass.

paper:clean_dry.preparation: Keep clean and dry; remove food, tape, and non-paper parts where practical.
paper:clean_dry.disposal: Paper may be accepted under general Perak guidance; check local collection rules.

paper:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate wet or food-soiled paper from clean recyclables.
paper:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not set out as recyclable while wet or contaminated; use local residual-waste guidance.

paper:broken_unsafe.preparation: Remove unsafe attachments only if safe to do so.
paper:broken_unsafe.disposal: Keep separate and ask the local provider if the material is unusual or contaminated.
paper:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Do not handle paper contaminated with chemicals or sharp objects.

paper:unknown.preparation: Check that it is paper, clean, and dry.
paper:unknown.disposal: Confirm local acceptance if coated, laminated, or heavily printed.

cardboard:clean_dry.preparation: Flatten, keep dry, and remove food residue and loose plastic where practical.
cardboard:clean_dry.disposal: Clean dry cardboard may be accepted; confirm local collection rules.

cardboard:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate wet, oily, or food-soiled cardboard.
cardboard:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not set out as recyclable while contaminated; follow local residual-waste guidance.

cardboard:broken_unsafe.preparation: Keep separate and remove unsafe attachments only if safe.
cardboard:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask the local provider about contaminated or unusual cardboard.
cardboard:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Do not handle chemically contaminated material.

cardboard:unknown.preparation: Check that it is clean and dry; flatten if practical.
cardboard:unknown.disposal: Confirm whether coated or laminated board is accepted locally.

plastic:clean_dry.preparation: Empty, rinse if safe, and dry; keep caps and labels attached unless local rules say otherwise.
plastic:clean_dry.disposal: Plastic acceptance depends on the item and local provider. Confirm before setting it out.
plastic:clean_dry.safety_warning: Do not include chemical containers unless local guidance permits them.

plastic:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate from clean recyclables; rinse only if safe and practical.
plastic:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not set out while contaminated; check local residual-waste guidance.

plastic:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle sharp or unsafe plastic pieces.
plastic:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask the local provider about safe disposal.
plastic:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep sharp fragments away from people and children.

plastic:unknown.preparation: Identify the item and check for contamination; empty and dry only if safe.
plastic:unknown.disposal: Confirm item-specific local acceptance before setting it out.
plastic:unknown.safety_warning: Do not include chemical or unknown-content containers.

biological:clean_dry.disposal: Use the appropriate local organics or residual-waste service; this is not accepted in recycling pickup.

biological:contaminated_wet.preparation: Keep contained and separate from recyclables.
biological:contaminated_wet.disposal: Follow local organics or residual-waste guidance.
biological:contaminated_wet.safety_warning: Avoid contact with leaking or decomposing material.

biological:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle unsafe biological material.
biological:broken_unsafe.disposal: Contact the appropriate local service for safe disposal.
biological:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep away from people and children.

biological:unknown.preparation: Keep separate until the material is identified.
biological:unknown.disposal: Confirm the correct local organics or residual-waste route.
biological:unknown.safety_warning: Avoid contact with unknown biological material.

hazard:batteries.preparation: Keep batteries separate and prevent terminals from contacting metal if safe to do so.
hazard:batteries.disposal: Never place batteries in community recycling pickup; use an approved local collection point.
hazard:batteries.safety_warning: Damaged batteries can heat, leak, or ignite.

hazard:bulbs.preparation: Keep bulbs intact and separate; do not dismantle.
hazard:bulbs.disposal: Use a local bulb or hazardous-waste collection route; acceptance varies.
hazard:bulbs.safety_warning: Broken bulbs may contain sharp glass or hazardous components.

hazard:e_waste.preparation: Keep electronic items separate and do not dismantle them.
hazard:e_waste.disposal: Use an approved local e-waste collection point.
hazard:e_waste.safety_warning: Remove batteries only if the device instructions say it is safe.

hazard:chemicals.preparation: Keep the material in its original labelled container; do not mix or transfer it.
hazard:chemicals.disposal: Contact the local authority or hazardous-waste service for instructions.
hazard:chemicals.safety_warning: Do not place chemicals in community pickup or drains.

hazard:sharp_objects.preparation: Do not handle loose sharp objects; use a rigid puncture-resistant container only if safe and locally recommended.
hazard:sharp_objects.disposal: Ask the local authority about safe sharps disposal.

hazard:other_hazards.preparation: Keep isolated and do not handle unknown hazardous material.
hazard:other_hazards.disposal: Contact the appropriate local authority or emergency service for direction.
hazard:other_hazards.safety_warning: Do not place unknown hazards in community pickup.

hazard_confirmation.preparation: Keep all declared hazards separate from items offered for pickup.
hazard_confirmation.disposal: Only continue after confirming hazards are removed from the recyclable items.
hazard_confirmation.safety_warning: This is general safety guidance, not an emergency response or legal determination.

fallback.preparation: Keep the item clean, dry, and separate until its material and condition are clear.
fallback.disposal: Confirm acceptance and disposal with your local collection provider.
fallback.safety_warning: Do not offer broken, sharp, contaminated, or hazardous items.
